description: Review logging and diagnostics for secret, prompt, source, and session exposure.

criteria.text: Logs and diagnostics do not expose credentials, prompts, source contents, session contents, or local evidence.
criteria.evidence: Cite the redaction or exclusion boundary and deterministic negative evidence.

criteria.text: Failures remain diagnosable using bounded metadata without retaining sensitive payloads.
criteria.evidence: Cite the emitted metadata and tests showing sensitive payload fields are absent.
